Container.Name: GhostDrive
Container.Description: Encrypted, redundant, multi-backend personal cloud drive — self-hosted web vault. Loopback-published by default; see the README before exposing the port.
Container.Overview:
GhostDrive is an encrypted personal cloud drive with a web UI. This container runs the web vault on your Unraid box.
**Data lives in /mnt/user/appdata/ghostdrive** (mapped to /data in the container). It holds keystore.json (the vault keystore), ghostdrive.db (encrypted metadata), and logs. The keystore is unrecoverable without your 24-word seed phrase — write the seed on paper, and do not keep the only copy of it inside the folder you back up.
**Networking, read this:** the web UI is published on port 8000 of the Unraid host. GhostDrive has no TLS and no auth beyond its own vault lock; keep the port on your trusted LAN or put a reverse proxy / Tailscale in front of it. Do not port-forward it to the internet.
Status: template maintained, but the image build and this exact template are UNTESTED against a real Unraid box — see the repo's packaging/unraid/README.md for the honest state and limitations.
